of.needed: whether the environment has Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime as a module dependency

consequence.statement: Any Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime must have its import statements and go.mod entries updated to use the new v2 module paths before building or deploying against Crossplane v2.0.0.

assertion.statement: The Go module path for Crossplane and Crossplane Runtime has changed from `github.com/crossplane/crossplane` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime` to include a `v2` suffix: `github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2`; all import statements in code must be updated.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for product-relationship renamed
